summary_en: 48,600 shares acquired for ¥82.1M (0.19% S/O) via open-market purchase Jun 16–30, 2026. Cumulative progress under Jun 15 board authorization for 300,000-share limit (1.18% S/O, ¥500M ceiling) through Sep 30, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Open-Market Purchase of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: SOFTCREATE HOLDINGS reported completion of an open-market share repurchase executed between June 16 and June 30, 2026 (settlement basis). The company acquired 48,600 shares for a total of ¥82,074,100 via the Tokyo Stock Exchange. This represents 0.19% of shares outstanding (calculated as 48,600 ÷ 25,426,000 ex-treasury shares). The purchase was conducted pursuant to a June 15, 2026 board resolution authorizing acquisition of up to 300,000 shares (1.18% S/O) within a ¥500M ceiling through September 30, 2026. The June 16–30 tranche is reported as cumulative progress toward that authorization limit.
